positive.description: Open the sample using the desktop CSV file viewer and inspect a leading-zero ID.
positive.prompt: Download sample.csv into a local workspace. Open it from the desktop app and select CSV Viewer if prompted. Check the row count, column count and first ID.
positive.expected_behavior: The viewer displays 36 data records across 9 columns. The first value in 编号 (ID) is 001. The separate # column shows source record numbers.

positive.description: Filter records by a Chinese word, then clear the filter.
positive.prompt: Open sample.csv in CSV Viewer. Enter 平衡 in the search field. Read the match count, then clear the search field.
positive.expected_behavior: The count changes from 36 records to 12 of 36. Clearing the search restores all 36 records.

positive.description: Sort IDs in descending order and restore the original order.
positive.prompt: Open sample.csv in CSV Viewer. Click the 编号 column header twice, check the first ID, then click 原始顺序 to restore the original order.
positive.expected_behavior: The first ID is 036 in descending order. After restoring the original order, the first ID is 001.

positive.description: Inspect the full text of a quoted multiline cell.
positive.prompt: Open sample.csv in CSV Viewer. Locate ID 002, scroll across to the 说明 column and click its cell. Read the two lines in the detail panel.
positive.expected_behavior: The expanded cell shows two lines. The second line is 这是同一个单元格中的第二行。 and the file still shows 36 data records.

positive.description: Switch the first row between headers and data.
positive.prompt: Open sample.csv in CSV Viewer. Clear the 首行为表头 checkbox, inspect the first row, then select it again.
positive.expected_behavior: With the box cleared, there are 37 records. The first value under 列 1 is 编号. With the box selected again, 编号 becomes a header and the count returns to 36.

negative.description: A cell containing a spreadsheet formula must be displayed literally.
negative.prompt: Open literal-values.csv in CSV Viewer and click the =1+1 cell in the 公式文本 column. Check whether opening the cell evaluates the formula.
negative.expected_behavior: Both the table and the cell detail show the four literal characters =1+1. The displayed value stays the same on inspection.

negative.description: A mailto address must not launch an external handler.
negative.prompt: Open literal-values.csv in CSV Viewer. Click the mailto:demo@example.invalid cell in the 非网页地址 column and inspect what opens.
negative.expected_behavior: The viewer opens the cell detail as text. No mail application or external page opens. The neighboring https://example.invalid/ cell is shown as a web link.

negative.description: An unmatched query must report an empty result.
negative.prompt: Open sample.csv in CSV Viewer. Search for no-matching-demo-record, inspect the empty state, then clear the query.
negative.expected_behavior: The viewer displays 没有匹配的记录。 and a count of 0 out of 36. Clearing the query restores all 36 original rows.

commerce_description: CSV Viewer is free and open source. It offers local file viewing and has no payment or purchase flow.
